sentences.en: To weep is to make less the depth of grief.
sentences.zh: 哭泣能减轻悲伤的深度。

sentences.en: It shows the depth of his love for his family.
sentences.zh: 这显示了他对家庭之爱的深厚程度。

sentences.en: As compared with his father, he is lacking in depth.
sentences.zh: 与他父亲相比，他在深刻性方面有所欠缺。

senses.zh: 深, 深度, 纵深 - 深厚, 深切, 深刻 - 深处, 深渊
